gender-orientation-dimensions.alt: Four separate bars. Biological sex (what body?): chromosomes, hormones and anatomy, and some people have intersex traits. Gender identity (who am I?): a person’s inner sense of being a woman, a man, both or neither. Gender roles (what is expected?): a culture’s expectations for how women and men act, dress and work. Sexual orientation (attracted to whom?): a lasting pattern of romantic or sexual attraction. Knowing one answer does not tell you the others.
